entries.b3d1622fef2e3d09: Based on the idea that corporate value is determined by the “surprise” and “delight” felt by customers who visit, its basic philosophy is the “Four Pledges to Customers”: “good products, cheaply, quickly, cleanly, and in the best atmosphere.” As its medium- to long-term management strategy, it states that it will raise added value in a way that responds to consumer needs while promoting more efficient store operations, thereby increasing the number of customers and strengthening the earnings base of its stores. As issues to address, it lists promoting the opening of new small stores, downsizing existing large stores by operating multiple brands in them, converting the formats of existing stores, improving systems such as table ordering systems, and developing retail channels through expansion of private brand products and strengthened development at its central kitchen.

entries.fc082df0bfb3c344: The company group operates in the eating-out industry, which runs restaurants, and in complementary businesses, and reports a single segment. The company operates 102 stores in total across 7 store formats (including 1 franchised store): Shunsen Sakaba Tengu (5 stores), Washoku Restaurant Tengu (14 stores), Tengu Sakaba (14 stores), Kandaya (24 stores), Meat Kitchen log50 (2 stores), Tengu Dai Hall (40 stores) and Minatoya Isokichi Shokudo (3 stores), and also produces ingredients for its stores at a central kitchen in Hidaka City, Saitama Prefecture. Consolidated subsidiary Tenwarudo Toreedingu Co., Ltd. imports and sells alcoholic beverages, foodstuffs and other products, and supplies alcoholic beverages and other products to the company. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,093 million.
